test_objective: Check that you can merge a batch of entities

test_cases.name: 057_01_01 MergeAnEmptyEntity
test_cases.doc: Check that you can merge a batch of entities
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Batch Merge Entities with Response Status Code set to 204     and
        Query Entities with Response body containing a list containing entity elements with different types and
            Query Parameter: filename set to 'expectation_filename' and
            Query Parameter: entities_representation_ids set to 'entities_ids_to_be_merged' and
            Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response1.json()' and
            Query Parameter: ignore_core_context_version set to 'True'
}
